items.title: Mark your calendars: European Sustainable Energy Week 23-25 June 2027
items.description: As Europe continues to strengthen its energy security, competitiveness and resilience, the European Sustainable Energy Week (EUSEW) will bring the clean energy community together to discuss key policy trends and perspectives.

items.title: 2027 arrangements for the execution of transfers between the emission trading registries of the EU and Switzerland
items.description: The 2027 arrangements for the transfers of emission allowances between the registries of the EU Emissions Trading System and the Swiss Emissions Trading System have been agreed, in application of the EU and Swiss Linking Agreement.

items.title: Representatives of European regions and local communities gather in Dublin to accelerate adaptation to climate change
items.description: Fifth EU Mission Forum on Adaptation to Climate Change to highlight importance of proactively preparing for climate risks, protecting people, and keeping Europe’s economy productive and competitive.

items.title: ACM: geen aanwijzingen dat gebruik prijssoftware door tankstations leidt tot hogere pompprijzen

items.description: Today, the European Union has endorsed the Antalya Compact for Energy Efficient Buildings, an initiative to reduce buildings’ energy intensity - energy consumed per m² - by at least 25% by 2035.

items.description: This morning, the European Parliament and Council reached a provisional agreement on the amendment to the EU Methane Regulation to postpone by 2 years the application of certain requirements for natural gas, crude oil and coal importers and EU operators.

items.description: The European Union (EU) today published its second Biennial Transparency Report (BTR2) under the Paris Agreement.

items.title: Commission welcomes political agreement on faster and simpler permitting for grids, clean energy projects
items.description: The European Commission welcomes the provisional political agreement reached by the European Parliament and the Council on new rules to simplify and accelerate permitting procedures for grids and clean energy infrastructure.
